summary: Rhea County lookout listed as removed in a Tennessee tower inventory; no other source found on its history.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed; no source describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

notes_for_editor: One source for the tower: a personal, unofficial inventory. The inventory gives no district-tower number for Spring City, unlike its Grandview and Smyrna neighbours. The record point (35.76368, -84.8838) is about 8.5 km north-northwest of Wikipedia's coordinates for the town (35.68944, -84.86389). The tower may stand well away from the town, or the record point may be off; no source describes the site, so no correction is proposed. The name may refer to the town only. No build, design, staffing or fire record found.
